guards: `--help` stays a pure read on every CLI: no filesystem write, no network, no mutating child process, and a --help / unknown-flag contract in the code

poisonPill.why: `arch-intent-bootstrap.mjs --help` RAN the bootstrap (2026-11-21) because the CLI ignored the flag. The census this gate encodes then found 54 CLIs where `--help` did real work, including a created git worktree and provider API calls. The pill overlays a CLI with no help contract that writes a file regardless of argv; the control run (the real, guarded CLI) must exit 0, so a crash in the harness cannot read as a detection.
